解析请求、维护异步响应通道，并把客户端生命周期转换为后端消息；HTTP 层不直接: Parses requests, maintains asynchronous response channels, and converts the client lifecycle into backend messages; the HTTP layer does not call the model directly.
usage 使用后端 token 计数；文本切片、SSE 消息和 token 边: usage uses backend token counts; text chunks, SSE messages, and token boundaries do not map one to one.
把文本协议转换为 token 协议，应用聊天模板，并维护增量反分词所需的上下文。: Converts the text protocol to a token protocol, applies chat templates, and maintains the context needed for incremental detokenization.
文本请求 / 调度器生成的 token IDs: Text requests / token IDs generated by the scheduler
UserMsg / 反分词增量与完成信息: UserMsg / incremental detokenization and completion information
num_tokenizer=0 时两类职责共享 worker；配置也支持独立 t: With num_tokenizer=0, both responsibilities share a worker; separate tokenizer workers are also supported. The diagram shows logical responsibilities, with ZMQ between processes.
Scheduler：批次与生命周期的所有者: Scheduler: owner of batches and lifecycles
维护 waiting / running 工作集合，在请求槽位、缓存容量和 to: Maintains waiting / running sets, builds a Batch subject to request slots, cache capacity, and token budgets, and reconciles completion and cancellation events.
新请求、资源余量、前一轮结果: New requests, available resources, previous-round results
ForwardInput；队列变化、结果消息与回收操作: ForwardInput; queue changes, result messages, and reclamation operations
Req 跨迭代保留身份与长度；Batch 只描述一次执行。Chunked pre: Req preserves identity and lengths across iterations; Batch describes one execution. Chunked prefill splits input work, while continuous batching regroups members at iteration boundaries.
持有模型、设备 stream、Attention backend、Sampler: Owns the model, device stream, Attention backend, Sampler, and GraphRunner; binds the current Batch in Context and selects eager forward or Graph replay.
Batch、采样参数与已准备的设备元数据: Batch, sampling parameters, and prepared device metadata
GPU / CPU token IDs 与 copy_done_event: GPU / CPU token IDs and copy_done_event
Engine 与 Scheduler 同属一个 worker 进程。overla: Engine and Scheduler share a worker process. The scheduler loop and streams/events coordinate overlap; Graph is an execution strategy, not a separate service.
模型定义层次与权重映射；Layers 组织矩阵与激活计算；Attention b: The model defines layers and weight mappings; Layers organize matrix and activation operations; the Attention backend interprets batch metadata and cache layouts to select kernels.
Context.batch、权重、位置与 KV 映射: Context.batch, weights, positions, and KV mappings
接入一个模型需要同时满足执行与状态契约。混合循环模型是扩展例子：请求状态不能只用: Model integration must satisfy both execution and state contracts. Hybrid recurrent models are one extension: Attention KV alone cannot represent all request state.
矩阵运算、Attention、逐元素算子与采样运行于设备；权重和通用 KV po: Matrix operations, Attention, elementwise operators, and sampling run on the device; weights and the general KV pool remain resident, while inputs and metadata update per batch.
设备张量、kernel launch / Graph replay: Device tensors, kernel launch / Graph replay
CPU 控制逻辑也会提交 GPU 元数据操作。设备结果须由 Scheduler: CPU control logic also submits GPU metadata operations. Scheduler must reconcile device results before they return through Detokenizer and HTTP.
KV pool 与设备地址映射: KV pool and device address mappings
MHAKVCache 持有按层组织的 K / V 设备 buffer；page_: MHAKVCache owns per-layer K / V device buffers; page_table maps token positions within each request to physical token slots. Separate objects manage cached data and allocation policy.
layer_id、K / V 张量、out_loc 与请求页表: layer_id, K / V tensors, out_loc, and request page tables
按物理位置写入 KV；供 Attention backend 读取历史: KV writes at physical positions; history reads by the Attention backend
buffer 布局为 [2, layers, pages, page_size,: The buffer layout is [2, layers, pages, page_size, local_kv_heads, head_dim]. CacheManager manages page allocation and prefix references; TableManager manages request rows. The pool itself does not choose eviction policy.
按 page 分配物理空间，写入请求映射；通过 radix handle 固定共: Allocates physical space by page and writes request mappings; pins shared prefixes through radix handles and evicts only cache entries not protected by active requests.
cached_len / device_len、prefix handle、空闲: cached_len / device_len, prefix handle, free pages
结束请求会归还引用与槽位，但有效前缀可留在 radix cache。只有驱逐或不: Finishing a request releases references and returns slots, but valid prefixes may remain in the radix cache. Physical pages return to the free list through reclamation operations such as eviction or releasing tails that cannot be retained.
TableManager：请求槽位与 token pool: TableManager: request slots and token pool
为活动请求分配 table_idx；该行连接请求身份、token_pool 和: Allocates table_idx for active requests; each row connects request identity, token_pool, and page_table, keeping scheduling identity distinct from physical KV addresses.
page_table 位于 GPU，条目是物理 token 槽地址；分配单位仍是: page_table resides on the GPU and stores physical token-slot addresses; allocation is still page-based. Reclaiming table_idx does not immediately free all KV pages for that request.
MTP：候选、验证与状态提交: MTP: candidates, verification, and state commit
MTPBatchHandler 将会话组织成 GPU 批次，GreedyMTPC: MTPBatchHandler organizes sessions into GPU batches; GreedyMTPController generates candidates, verifies them to determine the accepted prefix, and reconstructs the target / draft states to commit.
pending token、last_hidden、独立 target / dr: pending token, last_hidden, independent target / draft states
接受前缀 + target bonus；新 pending 与会话状态: Accepted prefix + target bonus; new pending token and session states
当前旁支由特定模型适配器提供，使用 greedy clone / replay；: This branch is supplied by a model-specific adapter and uses greedy clone / replay; it is not a transaction framework enabled for every model. MTP does not automatically inherit mixed / Graph / overlap compatibility from the ordinary path.
HTTP 与编码层将协议请求转换为后端消息。Scheduler 接收新请求及取消: HTTP and encoding layers convert protocol requests into backend messages. Scheduler receives new requests and cancellations; client connections do not directly call GPU work.
请求身份跨批次稳定: Request identity stays stable across batches
编码后的消息进入调度队列: Encoded messages enter the scheduling queue
PrefillManager 匹配可复用前缀，并在容量允许时分配请求行、锁定命中: PrefillManager matches reusable prefixes, then allocates request rows and locks matched handles when capacity permits. Request slots, KV capacity, and this round's token budget all constrain runnable work.
03 · 从请求集合构造一次执行: 03 · Build one execution from the request set
PrefillManager / DecodeManager 选择本轮工作，构造: PrefillManager / DecodeManager select this round's work and build a Batch. Chunking controls the number of new tokens; scheduling policy determines how prefill and decode share the budget.
批次临时，请求状态持久: Batches are temporary; request state persists
本轮成员及新增区间确定: This round's members and new input ranges are determined
Scheduler 分配新增页、形成扁平 input_ids / positio: Scheduler allocates new pages and forms flattened input_ids / positions / out_loc; the backend inside Engine initializes Attention metadata. Context temporarily binds the current Batch for model layers.
映射写入已分配的 KV 槽: Mappings point to allocated KV slots
逻辑位置与物理地址解耦: Logical positions are decoupled from physical addresses
计算输入和缓存地址就绪: Compute inputs and cache addresses are ready
Engine 在设备 stream 上执行 eager forward 或可用的: Engine runs eager forward or available Graph replay on its device stream, then samples and initiates an asynchronous CPU copy of token IDs. The GPU does not send network responses directly.
设备状态前移；主机结果待就绪: Device state advances; host results are not yet ready
完成事件约束读取时机: Completion events constrain when data can be read
本轮 GPU 工作已提交: This round's GPU work has been submitted
Scheduler 等待对应拷贝事件，更新主机 token 序列、检查 EOS: Scheduler waits for the corresponding copy event, updates host token sequences, checks EOS / length limits, and creates detokenization messages. With overlap, it can submit the next batch before processing the previous batch's results.
本轮主机结果可读: This round's host results are readable
输出只提交给所属请求: Output is committed only to its owning request
结果可交给反分词层: Results can be passed to the detokenization layer
Detokenizer 将 token 增量转换成可发送文本，前端继续 SSE: Detokenizer converts token increments into sendable text; the frontend continues SSE or aggregates a non-streaming response. usage retains backend token counts and cannot be calculated from message counts.
增量文本发送给客户端: Incremental text is sent to the client
未结束请求回到 decode 集合；新请求可以参与后续调度。上一轮输出成为下一轮: Unfinished requests return to the decode set; new requests can join subsequent scheduling. The previous output becomes the next input, and Batch membership may change. This boundary also determines which state must survive across iterations.
保留请求身份、缓存引用和生成位置: Preserve request identity, cache references, and generation position
连续批处理在迭代边界生效: Continuous batching takes effect at iteration boundaries
循环回到第 03 步，直到完成: Loop back to step 03 until completion
请求行可复用；前缀可能仍驻留: Request rows are reusable; prefixes may remain resident
生命周期结束，缓存策略继续生效: The lifecycle ends; cache policy continues to apply
07 · 取消转化为调度事件: 07 · Turn cancellation into a scheduling event
客户端断开后，前端经消息通道发送取消。取消控制的是后续调度与结果可见性，不是强制: After a client disconnects, the frontend sends cancellation through the message channel. Cancellation controls subsequent scheduling and result visibility; it does not forcibly interrupt submitted CUDA kernels.
等待 / 运行集合移除该请求: Remove the request from waiting / running sets
连接关闭不等于资源已回收: Closing a connection does not mean resources are reclaimed
客户端不再等待增量结果: The client no longer waits for incremental results
取消处理必须与已提交批次的结果收敛协调，避免陈旧结果继续输出，也避免请求槽复用后: Cancellation handling must coordinate with result reconciliation for submitted batches, preventing stale output and writes into another request after slot reuse. Resources are released within the scheduling lifecycle.
不再为已取消请求安排下一轮: No next round is scheduled for the cancelled request
槽位复用不得改变请求身份: Slot reuse must not change request identity
释放请求行与活动引用；通用 radix 路径仍按缓存策略保留有效前缀。模型适配器: Release request rows and active references; the general radix path still retains valid prefixes according to cache policy. Adapters with independent recurrent state also need the corresponding release. Cancellation does not mean clearing all KV.
活动请求结束；缓存可供复用或驱逐: The active request ends; cache is reusable or evictable
两类资源分别回收: Reclaim the two resource types separately
已遵循系统减少动态效果设置，仅显示离散步骤。: Reduced-motion preference is respected; only discrete steps are shown.
